svg.title: Maricel CDL Success Hub Visual Mastery
svg.desc: Beginner backing poster with Maricel truck diagrams. Driver-view directions distinguish starting an intentional trailer turn from correcting straight-back drift. GOAL, mirror references, alignment, following and stop decisions. Educational support for instructor-supervised practice, not a vehicle simulation.

g.text: Start from zero. Understand what you see. Practice with your instructor.
Top view: truck front ↓. Driver RIGHT = screen LEFT. Driver LEFT = screen RIGHT.
Left/right wheel inputs mean moving the TOP of the wheel from the seated driver’s viewpoint. These are not mirror views.

Educational support for a left-hand-drive tractor and one semitrailer. Independent concept drawings, not to scale: no fixed wheel turns, timing, safe angle, vehicle
trajectory or guaranteed outcome. Practice with qualified instruction and follow equipment, site and current state test procedures.

a.text: Coach Maricel • Sources: Oregon CDL Manual §§2.2.4, 6.1.7 & 12; OSHA spotter guidance • maricelcdlsuccesshub.com/backing-poster
